baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction خلقناهم مما يعلمون joins origination to a source material that the addressees know.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bringing beings into existence from an acknowledged source makes their dependence, rather than autonomous rank, the premise of the denial.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into being supplies the act that derives them from prior material rather than from themselves.
Knowledge as disclosure makes that dependent origin an admitted datum available to the addressees.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a denial followed by a generic statement that God made them.
changed_reading.after: The denial appeals to a material origin they themselves recognize: beings brought from dependent material possess no self-grounded claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خلقناهم can foreground proportioned formation, while يعلمون can make the formed result a recognizable sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measurement precedes completed form, and completed form bears an identifying mark; the body therefore functions as inspectable evidence of creaturely measure.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning turns creation from an undifferentiated act into an apportioned constitution.
Complete balanced form supplies the visible result in which that apportionment can be inspected.
A distinguishing mark makes the formed body evidence that guides its bearer back to the fact of being measured.

changed_reading.before: Creation is only a past manufacturing event.
changed_reading.after: Their present, proportioned form is itself a readable marker of dependence and limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inward-disposition branch of خلق permits مما يعلمون to resonate with a makeup recognizable from their own conduct.
baseline_models.mechanism: If creation includes constitution of character, self-knowledge can expose the tendencies out of which their present claim arises.

activation_trace.role: Inner disposition supplies a created makeup rather than merely an external bodily product.
Disclosure to the knower makes that makeup something their experience can reveal to them.

changed_reading.before: What they know is only an unspecified physical substance.
changed_reading.after: The clause may also confront them with a created constitution whose impulses they already recognize from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier contrast between their seeing the event as distant and the divine seeing it as near narrows يعلمون to a deliberately modest evidentiary concession: even observers who mis-scale the future cannot evade the close evidence of their own origin.

activation_trace.role: Vision by eye or insight supplies the contested act of apprehension whose scale is corrected by the next verse.
Distance supplies their mistaken placement of the promised event outside practical reach.
Nearness reverses that placement and makes embodied origin the comparably close datum invoked in the focus.

structural_cues: 70:6-7 repeats seeing with a subject reversal and an antithesis of distant and near.
The focus does not credit them with unrestricted insight; it says only that they know the source from which they were created.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed visual estimates and the focus's appeal to knowledge; I infer that origin is selected as minimum common ground against bad eschatological judgment. A live alternative is that the cognition contrast and reproductive knowledge are unrelated.

changed_reading.before: What they know is a neutral report about their knowledge.
changed_reading.after: What they know is a strategic evidentiary concession: their temporal vision may fail, but their own close, embodied origin is enough to defeat the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated creation statement at 70:19 names an anxious, grasping human propensity, but the exception sequence answers it with sustained and guarded practices. The focus therefore invokes known constitution as a starting condition that neither excuses conduct nor guarantees honor.

activation_trace.role: Creation as inner disposition makes the earlier passive creation statement an explicit account of human makeup.
Anxious greed and rapid disturbance specify the created propensity that later behavior must govern.
Continuity and settled persistence supply a temporal discipline opposed to rapid anxious reaction.
Persevering observance supplies active maintenance that keeps created propensity from dictating outcome.

structural_cues: 70:19-21 states creation, adversity panic, and prosperity withholding before 70:22 introduces an exception.
70:35 grants honor only after the repeated relative-clause catalogue of maintained practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a created propensity and a sustained exception pattern; I infer that practice can govern the propensity, so creation is neither deterministic excuse nor admission credential. A live alternative is that 70:39 refers only to physical material.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely humiliates people by recalling lowly biological material.
changed_reading.after: It also rejects creation as excuse or entitlement: a known anxious and withholding constitution is governable, and mere possession of it does not make one honored.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed, known right is assigned to the requester and deprived, whereas every nearby man covets admission for himself. The recurrence of علم makes the focus's appeal to what they know ethically accusatory: acknowledged allocation is displaced by an ungrounded personal claim.

activation_trace.role: A binding fixed entitlement supplies the legitimate claim against which wished-for admission is measured.
Known disclosure makes that social right explicit and echoes the focus's appeal to their knowledge.
Covetous hope supplies the self-directed claim that lacks the fixed status of the earlier known right.

structural_cues: 70:24-25 directs a known right outward to requester and deprived; 70:38 turns to each man's desired entry, and 70:39 begins with كلا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one explicitly known entitlement and one coveted admission; I infer that the repeated علم invites an ethical contrast between acknowledged duty and imagined privilege. A live alternative is that يعلمون in the focus names only reproductive matter.

changed_reading.before: The knowledge clause concerns origin without ethical force.
changed_reading.after: Their known origin becomes self-indicting alongside the known right they owe: shared creaturehood cannot be converted into a private claim to entry while others' fixed claims are ignored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same context root spans a duration's exact measure and the Creator's ability immediately after the focus. It activates the measuring branch of خلق so that constitution, temporal scale, and capacity belong to one regime of limit-setting rather than to human self-assignment.

activation_trace.role: An amount reaching its defined limit supplies exact scale rather than indefinite duration.
Effective capacity joins measure to an agent able to realize and alter what has been apportioned.

structural_cues: 70:4 uses مقدار for the immense day, while 70:40 follows the focus with إنا لقادرون.
The focus's first-person plural creator is repeated in the capacity claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact amount and effective capacity under one root; I infer a governing arrow from apportionment to realizable constitution. A live alternative is that the two قدر uses remain separate lexical functions and do not sharpen خلق.

changed_reading.before: Created means only brought into existence.
changed_reading.after: Created also means placed under exact measure by a capacity that can realize, limit, and alter the present constitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel moves from known creation to a better substitute that can stand in the present cohort's place, with no possibility of frustrating the agent. First creation therefore establishes reproducibility, not an ontological monopoly held by those now demanding entry.

activation_trace.role: Excellence and selection supply the qualitative criterion by which the substitute can be better.
One thing standing in another's place makes the created population replaceable rather than indispensable.
Failure to escape the pursuer closes the possibility that the present cohort can prevent substitution.

structural_cues: 70:40-41 continues the first-person plural voice of خلقناهم with power to replace them by better and denial of being outstripped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, superior substitution, and inability to escape; I infer that first creation is the enabling precedent for replacement. A live alternative is that substitution is only a threat to a population and says nothing about how 70:39's source material functions.

changed_reading.before: Their created humanity is a stable status from which they can claim admission.
changed_reading.after: Their known manufacture proves that this cohort is reproducible and replaceable; current membership in humanity grants neither indispensability nor entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene brings concealed bodies out of graves. Read backward through that scene, creation from an already known source is not merely humiliating memory but the accessible control case for another bodily emergence.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a thing out from concealment supplies the transition from hidden remains to manifested bodies.
The grave identifies the second hidden source from which the created subjects emerge.

structural_cues: 70:39 names first creation, 70:40-41 asserts capacity, and 70:43 depicts rapid exit from graves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first origin, intervening capacity, and grave emergence; I infer that known first creation warrants repeat embodiment. A live alternative is that 70:39 only rebuts entitlement and the grave scene independently depicts judgment.

changed_reading.before: The verse looks backward only to a lowly beginning.
changed_reading.after: The known beginning also looks forward: the first emergence is evidence that concealed bodies can be brought out again for the promised encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crowd's facing formation and the distributive every man create local units of proximity and expectation. The plural خلقناهم and common source reset all those units to one dependent material class, so spatial closeness and factional placement cannot manufacture rank.

activation_trace.role: A group facing one another supplies the social formation clustered before the addressee.
Totalizing every distributes the admission claim to each member while keeping the whole crowd in view.

structural_cues: 70:36-37 places them before the messenger, on the right and left in bands; 70:38 individualizes the hope with كل امرئ; 70:39 returns to the plural object هم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a facing crowd, lateral bands, and each member's hope; I infer that shared material origin cancels proximity as a rank-producing mechanism. A live alternative is that the spatial description is merely visual staging.

changed_reading.before: The denial addresses isolated individuals who overestimate themselves.
changed_reading.after: It also dismantles a crowd-based status claim: neither being near, in a favored side-group, nor one among the total can override the common created source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ء ل to س ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary asking sense. It remains anchored in خلقناهم مما and is reinforced by a branch of offspring separated from a mother; downstream prose should present it only as an extraction-and-lineage resonance, not as a claim that سأل lexically means lineage here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The preposition مما and the act خلقناهم can host an image of beings drawn out as a derivative line from prior life.

activation_trace.role: Origination from another thing anchors the proposed extracted lineage in the focus's act of creation.
The explicitly supplied non-dominant branch pictures an extracted lineage and activates serial derivation from prior material.
Offspring separated from mother or nursing supplies a concrete generational separation within that line.

changed_reading.before: The known source material remains unspecified and static.
changed_reading.after: It can be pictured exploratorily as an extracted, separated lineage: each cohort is drawn from prior life, so no member is self-originating or privately privileged.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context word denotes garden while its branch inventory also contains the hidden fetus. It remains valid as a branch-level inversion anchored in created source, entry, and enclosure; downstream prose should mark it as imagistic resonance rather than the contextual sense of جنة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خلقناهم مما names dependent emergence from a source, immediately after the wish to be made to enter a garden.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being from another thing anchors gestational dependence in the focus.
Entry into an interior supplies the desired movement whose merit is denied.
The fetus hidden in the belly supplies a prior involuntary enclosure from which created life emerged.

changed_reading.before: They seek entry into an enclosed garden as though admission confirmed inherent worth.
changed_reading.after: Their wished-for entry is inverted by an earlier hidden enclosure: they first emerged as dependent fetuses, and that involuntary origin cannot count as earned garden admission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the mark branch of علم with contextual witness and boundary-marker branches. It remains anchored in the focus's proportioned formation and knowledge, but downstream prose should qualify it as a material-sign model rather than a lexical paraphrase of يعلمون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branches of خلق and علم permit the created form itself to be a distinguishing sign that its bearer can know.

activation_trace.role: Complete visible form supplies the material surface on which creaturely evidence can appear.
A distinguishing mark converts bodily form into a guide toward known origin.
A witnessing sign supplies the evidentiary function assigned to the body's created marks.
A set boundary marker gives the sign model a concrete image of evidence made conspicuous.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge of origin is an inward proposition remembered by the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Their proportioned bodies can themselves stand as witnessing markers: origin is not only remembered but materially signaled in the form they inhabit.

strongest_changes: The 70:19-35 sequence turns created propensity from deterministic fate into a governable starting condition.
The known right of 70:24 and coveted entry of 70:38 make يعلمون ethically accusatory rather than merely anatomical.
The 70:40-43 sequel turns first creation into evidence of measured capacity, cohort replacement, and bodily re-emergence.
The far-near seeing contrast makes their known origin the minimum close evidence that survives their distorted estimate of the future.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots supported a compact bridge among material origin, inward disposition, measure, and self-witness. The packet's authorized split mapping also preserved an extracted-lineage reading, while the garden-fetus and bodily-marker models remained contained outliers rather than being forced into the main trace.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate referent of مما may be reproductive material alone or may tolerate the broader constitutional resonances activated here.
The echo between حق معلوم and مما يعلمون may be deliberate ethical recurrence or only associative root repetition.
Replacement of a cohort and re-emergence from graves are mechanically distinct, but the sequence may intend one combined demonstration of creative capacity.
